final_message:
Accented titles now keep their base letters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the previously failing one.

The fix is one line in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented characters (NFD) and strips the combining accent marks before passing the title to `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/slugify`, because the vendor README says that folder is replaced on upgrades, not edited by hand.

The shop's `product-url.js` also uses the vendored `slugify`, so product names with accents will still lose those letters. I left it alone because you asked about blog URLs. If you want the same behavior for products, the one-line change would go there too.

I didn't commit anything.
